description.value: Nordstrom NYC Flagship is the chain's big Manhattan store; one guest writes, I really enjoy shopping at the Nordstrom on 57th Street. Reviewers describe the edit as curated rather than huge: The selection is a bit smaller compared to some other department stores, but in my opinion it feels much more curated. Services are a draw, from personal styling (I recently had an appointment in the Stylist Lounge at Nordstrom) to beauty, where one shopper Came in today looking for a perfume and ended up walking out with 2!, and another says it has the most amazing lighting and dressing rooms. Wikipedia adds that the basement and first five above-ground stories of Central Park Tower contain a large Nordstrom store, which opened in 2019. The Exa listing shows Rating 4.4 out of 5 · 1,761 reviews. Representative aggregated guest reviews praise: “The store has a beautiful, modern design”. Representative watch-outs: “Prices are generally on the high side”.
